content.instruction: Write a job application. You are applying for a Director-General position at the International Organization for Migration. Tell about your experience in migration policy, refugee protection, and humanitarian assistance. Describe your vision for IOM's role in managing global migration and securing migrants' rights. Also reflect on the status of climate refugees. Length about 450 words.
